title: Calls per minute: Poisson with mean 3
caption: Calls arrive at random at an average rate of 3 a minute, so the count is Poisson(3). P(no calls) = e⁻³ = 0.0498.
alt: Bar chart of the Poisson distribution with mean 3 for 0 to 10 calls; the bar for 0 is shaded.
description: Random arrivals at a steady average rate suggest a Poisson model with λ = 3.
The bar at 0 has height e⁻³ ≈ 0.0498.
